productos.resumen: Core platforms, profiles and a simple weekly routine
productos.descripcion_html:
A starter guide for small business owners who want a clear, low-stress way to show up on social media.

What's inside

  • Choosing platforms: how to pick the one or two channels that fit your business.
  • Profile set-up: bio, photo, links and highlights that explain what you do.
  • Weekly routine: a simple posting and replying schedule.
  • First 30 posts: prompts organised by goal.

Format

PDF ebook. Instant delivery by email. Read on any device.

This guide is educational and is not a substitute for professional advice. No specific results are guaranteed.

Digital product only. No physical item is shipped.
